typed_equivalent.label: WRITE A SHORT ANSWER
typed_equivalent.instruction: Write a scientifically or linguistically equivalent answer.

typed_short.label: WRITE A SHORT ANSWER
typed_short.instruction: Write the precise short answer requested.

controlled_translation.label: TRANSLATE
controlled_translation.instruction: Translate the complete stimulus and preserve every required idea and form.

spelling_restore.label: RESTORE THE SPELLING
spelling_restore.instruction: Use the clue and restore the complete target-language spelling.
spelling_restore.answerFormat: Type the whole word or phrase.

listen_type.label: LISTEN AND TYPE
listen_type.instruction: Listen, then type the complete French word or phrase.
listen_type.answerFormat: Type what you hear; accents are taught but not deducted.

word_tiles.label: BUILD THE ANSWER
word_tiles.instruction: Arrange all tiles to build the complete correct answer.

unordered_set.label: GIVE ALL ITEMS
unordered_set.instruction: Give every requested item; order does not matter.
unordered_set.answerFormat: Separate items with commas, slashes, semicolons, 'and', 'et', or new lines.

matching.label: MATCH THE PAIRS
matching.instruction: Match every item to its correct partner.

sequence.label: PUT IN ORDER
sequence.instruction: Arrange every step or item in the correct order.

sorting.label: SORT THE ITEMS
sorting.instruction: Place every item in the correct scientific category.

calculation.label: CALCULATE
calculation.instruction: Show the method, calculate the answer and include the required unit.
calculation.answerFormat: Enter working and a final value with unit.

mark_points.label: SHORT EXAM ANSWER
mark_points.instruction: Write enough distinct scientific points for the available marks.

practical_design.label: DESIGN THE PRACTICAL
practical_design.instruction: Specify variables, controls, method quality and the requested analysis.

diagram_label.label: LABEL THE DIAGRAM
diagram_label.instruction: Place every required label on the correct structure.
diagram_label.answerFormat: Use each label once unless instructed otherwise.

extended_response.label: EXTENDED RESPONSE
extended_response.instruction: Build a linked answer using the mark points as a checklist after submitting.
extended_response.answerFormat: Write linked scientific sentences, then self-check against the rubric.
